name: Footnote
oneLiner: Source-grounded community notes for Bluesky, with separate evidence and tone judgments, immutable history, writer bonds, and appeals on GenLayer.
description: Footnote adds public context to Bluesky posts. GenLayer validators read the post and allowlisted sources, verify exact quotes, and assign Supported, Contradicted, Unsupported, or Misleading independently from Rage bait, Not rage bait, or Unclear. Notes preserves every version; Recheck re-reads evidence; Appeals judges counter-evidence within 72 hours; Bonds manages writer stakes and receipt-verified pull withdrawals. Allegations about people use a stricter two-label rule and keep names, handles, and post text off-chain. Reading needs no wallet. StudioNet is a simulator. Real finalized notes and explorer receipts are linked; the source-change replay is explicitly test-only.
expectedOutcome: Help readers inspect what supplied sources establish, separate factual support from provocative tone, and challenge notes with new evidence. Demonstrate four working GenLayer contracts with auditable finality, per-address spam limits, immutable history, and verified native-credit withdrawals. Labels remain judgments about sources, not guarantees of truth.
howTo: Open Evidence desk and select a community note. Read Evidence and Tone separately.
Read The sources and open the exact quotation in its public source.
Open Live proof and watch the clearly marked test-only source-change replay.
Choose Write a note, use Stake bond then Publish note; use Recheck sources or Contest note · 2 GEN for new evidence.
